checklist_templates.name: Weekly Grocery Shopping
checklist_templates.guidance: Check pantry first; select quantities; mark items already at home.

checklist_templates.name: Vegetables & Fruits Refill
checklist_templates.guidance: Choose seasonal produce; use kg/g or pc/bunch according to shop.

checklist_templates.name: Non-Vegetarian Shopping
checklist_templates.guidance: Keep chilled/frozen items safe; note weight and portion.

checklist_templates.name: Office Workday Checklist
checklist_templates.guidance: Check laptop, charger, access, meetings, and task priorities.

checklist_templates.name: Travel Packing Checklist
checklist_templates.guidance: Duplicate for each trip and customize by weather and destination.

checklist_templates.name: Medical Appointment Prep
checklist_templates.guidance: Bring relevant records and medication list; follow clinician instructions.

checklist_templates.name: Exam Preparation
checklist_templates.guidance: Track syllabus, revision, mock tests, and required documents.

checklist_templates.name: Home Cleaning Routine
checklist_templates.guidance: Assign tasks to household members and set recurring frequency.

checklist_templates.name: Baby Essentials Refill
checklist_templates.guidance: Adjust to the child's age and caregiver guidance.

checklist_templates.name: Pet Care Routine
checklist_templates.guidance: Use veterinarian instructions for prescribed products.

checklist_templates.name: Vehicle Monthly Check
checklist_templates.guidance: Track service dates, insurance, documents, and safety checks.

checklist_templates.name: Festival / Event Planning
checklist_templates.guidance: Estimate guests and quantities; assign owners.

checklist_templates.name: Garden & Farm Tasks
checklist_templates.guidance: Adapt tasks to crop, season, soil, water availability, and local advice.

checklist_templates.name: Digital Security & Bills
checklist_templates.guidance: Avoid storing passwords, OTPs, or full sensitive IDs in checklist notes.

recommended_item_fields.quantity: Decimal; allow null for task-only items

measurement_guidance.rule: Use kg for larger produce and bulk staples; g for small amounts and spices.
Use pc for countable items; let users switch to kg when shops sell by weight.
measurement_guidance.examples: Lemon 4 pc or 500 g; coconut 1 pc or kg

measurement_guidance.rule: Use bunch for leafy greens only if the local vendor sells by bunch; otherwise use g.
Use ml/L for liquids and g/kg for solids; do not convert mass to volume without a product-specific density.
measurement_guidance.examples: Milk 1 L; oil 1 L; paneer 200 g

measurement_guidance.rule: Use pack/box/bottle when package size varies; optionally add pack_size and pack_size_unit.
Use task for non-purchasable actions and documents.
Do not hard-code one default unit as universally correct. Allow per-item and per-list overrides.
measurement_guidance.examples: Bananas can be kg, dozen, or pc depending on the shop.
